title: Compact reviewed-draft calibration for Claude

basis.note: All inspected sources are draft or held. No primary manga chapter was newly inspected for this proposal.

aggregate_non_unique.note: Non-unique: S34 integrates S003R/S004A/S004B records, so do not treat the total as a unique roster.

classification_rules.reviewed_reference: Non-Held draft record that either has graded evidence in S60, or is a revised/secondary-confirmed/secondary-snippet-reviewed draft in the integrated expansion set with a usable rationale. It remains a draft reference, not a rating source of truth.
classification_rules.preliminary_disputed: Draft record with recollection-only or not-checked support, explicit dispute/conditional flags, unresolved identity/version, or a held flag in any inspected source snapshot. It is excluded from rating examples.
classification_rules.held_exclusion: Any name in held_excluded_from_all_reference_examples is barred from every rating example even if a later integrated file promoted it to draft.
classification_rules.precedence: If a name is held in any source or appears in preliminary_disputed, it is not a reviewed_reference anchor.

use_policy: Calibration only: do not mark any Batch 005 record approved, publish it, or treat this proposal as permission to import. Keep outputs draft/review until the owner explicitly changes status.

Use anchors for relative ordering and role-shape calibration only. Never copy an anchor's Power or Fit onto a Batch 005 character; match canonical version, demonstrated feats, and evidence level first.
R1 outranks R2, which outranks R3. Even R1 sources are draft with unverified references; cite them as reviewed draft anchors, not as verified canon.
Never show, quote, or reason from any record in held_excluded_from_all_reference_examples as a rated example. A HELD_TO_DRAFT revision does not erase the original held flag for calibration purposes.

Records in non_anchor_bulk_preliminary_drafts or explicit_disputed_watchlist cannot be used as anchors. Treat them as targets for verification or as reasons to hold a rating if no reasonable basis exists.

Do not infer Power or Fit from clan, rank, affiliation, family role, occupation, or equipment alone. Borrowed tools, one-time fatal techniques, reanimation regeneration, and conditional transformations are excluded unless explicitly approved by the applicable policy and supported by evidence.

Treat search_result_summary, secondary_snippet_inspected, secondary_search_snippet_only, and recollection_only as unverified priors. Prefer primary manga chapter evidence for any rating above the matched anchor band or for disputed/conditional cases.

For Batch 005, whose research package is mostly search_result_summary, start from the nearest R3/R2 archetype, label confidence low/medium accordingly, and flag targeted verification needs rather than escalating to high confidence.
If identity, version, or manga-vs-anime status is unclear, preserve the ambiguity in review_flags and ask for owner decision; do not resolve it by assumption.
Keep the exact lowercase status values from sources (draft/held). This file itself is proposal_review_only and carries no approval claim.

instructions: PASS A ONLY. Do not read power_reference until all seven Fit ratings for all 100 candidates are fixed.
Use these reviewed draft anchors for relative role-shape calibration only; never copy a rating.
R1 outranks R2, which outranks R3. All anchors are Draft with unverified references, not Approved.
If a candidate resembles a preliminary/disputed or Held-excluded record, do not use that resemblance as an anchor.

tier_definitions.R1: Graded-evidence anchors from the initial 60 review (evidence grade A at record level). Strongest relative anchors, but source verification_status remains unverified.
tier_definitions.R2: Revised or secondary-confirmed draft anchors from the integrated expansion set. Medium confidence or explicit secondary confirmation; primary manga still unverified.
tier_definitions.R3: Thin secondary-snippet or recollection-based draft anchors. Use only as weak priors and require corroboration.

anchors.name: Madara Uchiha
anchors.rationale: Perfect Susanoo and large-scale techniques against the Five Kage and Alliance; long-range Eye of the Moon Plan and command of the Zetsu army.
anchors.use_hint: Upper scale anchor: P5, high combat/offense with strategic command; version is disputed.

anchors.name: Naruto Uzumaki
anchors.rationale: Sage Mode defeats Pain's bodies; Kurama chakra modes and Tailed Beast Bombs against Obito and later opponents.
anchors.use_hint: Upper scale anchor; version/policy-dependent and shared Kurama events.

anchors.name: Kakashi Hatake
anchors.rationale: Kamui rescues and repositions allies; fights Obito with Raikiri and Sharingan analysis; ANBU background supports stealth.
anchors.use_hint: High jonin anchor: support/assassin emphasis, borrowed-power caveat.

anchors.name: Shikamaru Nara
anchors.rationale: Plan defeats the immortal Hidan by trapping and burying him; repeated shadow binding enables allies.
anchors.use_hint: Nara-template anchor: low Power with Strategist 5 and Support 4.

anchors.name: Sakura Haruno
anchors.rationale: Prepares an antidote and stabilizes serious Alliance casualties; chakra-enhanced strength in combat.
anchors.use_hint: Combat-medic anchor below Tsunade; Healer 4, Power 3.

anchors.name: Tsunade
anchors.rationale: Katsuyu enables mass healing; super strength and medical skill against Orochimaru and Kabuto.
anchors.use_hint: Top medical anchor: Healer 5, Power 4.

anchors.name: Shikaku Nara
anchors.rationale: Chief Strategist who redesigns battle formations for the Alliance and is praised for it; shadow binding assists.
anchors.use_hint: Nara elder template: Power 2, Strategist 5, Captain 4.

anchors.name: Darui
anchors.rationale: Raikage's right hand with Black Lightning; commanded the First Division.
anchors.use_hint: High-end jonin/divisional commander anchor: Power 4.

anchors.name: Neji Hyuga
anchors.rationale: Byakugan and Gentle Fist specialist with sound tactical reading; shield technique and final interception protect allies, though the fatal act is a one-time demonstration.
anchors.use_hint: Hyuga combat anchor: Power 3, Tank 4; do not reuse one-time sacrifice as repeatable power.

anchors.name: Hinata Hyuga
anchors.rationale: Byakugan scouting and Gentle Fist offense; intercepted Pain's attack for Naruto; carries minor medical supplies only.
anchors.use_hint: Hyuga defensive/support anchor; Healer 1 reflects minor supplies only.

anchors.name: Ino Yamanaka
anchors.rationale: Relays information between Alliance units and links minds; limited medical training; weak direct combat.
anchors.use_hint: Yamanaka-template anchor: Power 2, Support 4, Healer 2.

anchors.name: Torune Aburame
anchors.rationale: Root member using rinkaichu with one-touch lethality; secondary rankings call the technique among the deadliest Aburame abilities. Integrated rating was revised down from Power 4 to Power 3.
anchors.use_hint: Aburame high-jonin anchor: Power 3, Attacker 4, Assassin 4; relies on secondary ranking.

anchors.name: Karin
anchors.rationale: Sensor who locates targets and heals others through her Heal Bite at a cost to herself.
anchors.use_hint: Sensor/healer anchor: Power 2, Support 4, Healer 3.

anchors.name: Choji Akimichi
anchors.rationale: Strong Expansion offense and durability; Butterfly Mode boosts him at a cost. Fatal pill state excluded.
anchors.use_hint: Akimichi anchor: Power 3, Tank 3; exclude fatal/one-time states.

anchors.name: Kiba Inuzuka
anchors.rationale: Tracking and fast ram attacks with Akamaru; modest durability and planning.
anchors.use_hint: Inuzuka combat anchor: Power 2, Attacker 3; ninken teamwork dependent.

anchors.name: Hiashi Hyuga
anchors.rationale: Hyuga clan head and Byakugan user with Gentle Fist and clan leadership; leadership is documented, combat is less documented in the sources reviewed.
anchors.use_hint: Hyuga clan-head anchor: Power 3 low confidence; leadership is not combat proof.

anchors.name: Hoheto Hyuga
anchors.rationale: Surprise Attack Division sensor/observer who used Byakugan to find explosive clay in a gourd; fit values conservative.
anchors.use_hint: Hyuga sensor anchor: Power 2, Support 3.

anchors.name: Muta Aburame
anchors.rationale: Aburame clan member using kikaichu and shokaichu; support is the expected specialism from insect-based sensing and swarm control.
anchors.use_hint: Lower Aburame anchor: Power 2, Support 3.

anchors.name: Zaji
anchors.rationale: Narutopedia lists him as a sensor-type detecting chakra within a range, serving as the division's sensor; distinct from a gambler also named Zaji.
anchors.use_hint: Low-end sensor anchor: Power 1, Support 3; identity disambiguated.

anchors.name: Shizune
anchors.rationale: Tsunade's medic apprentice and aide; competent treatment and poison use; modest combat power.
anchors.use_hint: Working medic anchor: Power 2, Healer 4.
